content.summary: The final provenance counts reconcile with the archive and rebuild evidence. Manuscript and canonical snapshot hashes match. Source retention, compilation coverage, root auditing, and delivery integrity remain distinct claims.

checks.scope: Final provenance counts and delivery scope
checks.method: Counted manifest modules, checked F29 counts, resolved both F37 target pairs, and verified the archive's 342 payload hashes.
checks.observation: The manifest contains 155 inherited and fourteen new Lean sources; F29 rebuilds only the root-reachable 100 inherited plus fourteen new modules and audits sixty-six roots. The archive has 342 payload files plus its hash inventory, with no compiled objects. Both preview/release target pairs match their recorded hashes. These delivery checks establish local byte identity, not viewer compatibility or theorem correctness. The manuscript explicitly retains cached Lean/mathlib/package trust and disclaims clean full-tree rebuilding and independently controlled reproduction.
